summary: Fix stale exit-code prose left behind by EXIT-CODE-CONTRACT and -COUNTS: a Dispatcher.ts comment and docs/CLI.md still describe the pre-§4(-amendment) contract

per.section: 4. Exit-code contract — the run never lies to CI

edit.description: Inline comment ~L577 (above the chainLoader try/catch; drifted from ~L492 via EXIT-CODE-CONTRACT-COUNTS's insertions) still says the supervisor 'logs and proceeds' on chain-resolution failure and exits non-zero — stale since 3a8d75e made this an EX_MOUNT_DEAD abort. Reword to match.

tick (~L30), loop (~L38), and job run (~L96) sections still document only exit 1 for chain/harness failure — add EX_MOUNT_DEAD (69) alongside, per §4. loop/job run sections also predate EXIT-CODE-CONTRACT-COUNTS (shipped): missing the errored-AND-nothing-shipped exit-1 condition, the partial-success stays-0 case, and the completion summary naming surfaced tick errors — cover the full amended §4 contract in one pass.

acceptance: Neither the Dispatcher.ts comment nor docs/CLI.md contradicts the shipped EX_MOUNT_DEAD (69) abort-on-first-occurrence contract.
notes: Audit finding from cross-checking 3a8d75e (EXIT-CODE-CONTRACT build) against §4: it updated the exported JSDoc and --help strings but missed this comment and docs/CLI.md. b37d172 (COUNTS) widened the same drift — folded in above rather than a second follow-up entry. Doc/comment-only, no behavior change.

summary: In-worktree afterCommit gate revert records the same per-entry trunk footprint the afterMerge path records, per spec/RELEASE-v0.7.md §13

per.section: 13. In-worktree gate reverts leave a trunk footprint

edit.description: runFanoutEntry's afterCommit-fail branch (~L1247-1266) capture git.showNameOnly(wt.path, postHead) before dropLastCommit; wave loop's `if (!r.committed...) continue` (~L935-936) feed that footprint into `observed` (mirror afterMerge's observed.set ~L1010) so commitPendingUpdate (~L975-1002) commits it to trunk, not just the gitignored PriorAttempt record.
New locked test mirroring the existing afterMerge footprint assertion (~L1379): an in-worktree afterCommit gate revert leaves the touched paths in the entry's observedFiles via a trunk commit.

tests.asserts: an in-worktree afterCommit gate revert's touched paths land in the entry's observedFiles via a trunk commit, matching the existing afterMerge footprint assertion at ~L1379

acceptance: A fanout tick reverted by an in-worktree gate is followed by a trunk commit naming the violating paths (next plan tick's commit-delta is non-empty, not a 50cc3ac3-shaped blind maintain); afterMerge footprint behavior unchanged; locked test covers the in-worktree revert path.
notes: Root cause read directly from source: wave loop's `if (!r.committed || !r.commitSha) continue` (Dispatcher.ts:936) skips observed-footprint capture entirely for in-worktree-reverted entries — only afterMerge-reverted entries reach it today. §13's third bullet (prompts/build.md fence-park instruction) is out of build's writablePaths (chain.ts excludes prompts/**) — routed to open-questions.md instead, not bundled here.

summary: Add locked test coverage for the shipped CJS-context refusal — 2d7b9f5 shipped with zero tests, per spec/RELEASE-v0.7.md §5

edit.description: Cover isCjsContextLoadFailure/loadChainModule against both empirical signatures (tsx 4.21 import-outside-module; tsx 4.23 ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND + %3Fnamespace%3D) throwing CjsContextLoadError, and a genuine unrelated ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND passing through unchanged.
Cover a CJS-context fixture load exiting 2 with the usage-shaped message, via tickExitCode's usageError branch and the render command's CjsContextLoadError catch.

tests.asserts: both known tsx signatures throw CjsContextLoadError naming "type": "module"; an unrelated ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND passes through unchanged
chain load in a CJS-context fixture prints the usage-shaped refusal and exits 2

acceptance: Locked tests cover §5's acceptance line directly: both empirical signatures refuse with exit 2 naming the fix; a genuinely missing dependency still surfaces as itself.
notes: 2d7b9f5 shipped Dispatcher.ts/cli.ts/CHANGELOG.md only, citing a prior tests/-outside-declared-files revert (4300b81) — but b578a41, which landed first in this same delta, already added tests/** to entryChannelPaths, so that risk no longer applies. Verified zero CjsContext/CJS matches in tests/ on disk.

summary: repoRoot walks up from cwd to the nearest .flume, mirroring git's .git resolution, per spec/RELEASE-v0.7.md §9

edit.description: Replace the literal repoRoot = process.cwd() (~L570) with a walk-up resolver per §9: cwd-is-.flume special case, no-.flume-found fallback to today's behavior, FLUME_DIR/FLUME_CONFIG_DIR overrides unchanged.
Cover: subdirectory-below-bay invocation resolves the same repoRoot as bay root; invocation from inside .flume; no .flume anywhere above cwd keeps cwd-as-root.

tests.asserts: cd .flume && flume job status resolves the same bay as running from repo root (no false 'no jobs'); a tree with no .flume anywhere above keeps today's cwd-as-root default.

acceptance: cd .flume && pnpm flume job status (or any subcommand) resolves the same bay as running from the repo root; a tree with no .flume anywhere above it keeps today's cwd-as-root default.

summary: Global bin re-execs a bay's local install when present, refuses loudly when pinned-but-absent, per spec/RELEASE-v0.7.md §10

per.section: 10. Engine↔pin handshake via launcher-defers-to-pin (the gradlew pattern)

edit.description: Before subcommand dispatch: three arms per §10 — local install at <bay>/.flume/node_modules/@dtmd/flume resolves → re-exec its CLI with the same argv/stdio; pinned in package.json but install absent → refuse exit 2 naming pin + readPackageVersion() (~L53-60); unpinned → unchanged.
Adjust only if the arms can't live entirely inside src/cli.ts's entry — build's call which site hosts the re-exec.
POSIX sibling; same caveat as bin/flume.js.
Version-stamped smoke fixtures distinguishing local vs global install per §10 acceptance.

tests.asserts: bay with local install present → any invocation re-execs it regardless of global version; local install removed on a pinned bay → refuses exit 2 naming pin + both versions; unpinned bay → byte-identical to today.

acceptance: A bay with the local install present re-execs it regardless of the global engine's version; the same bay with the local install removed refuses (exit 2) naming the pin and both versions; an unpinned bay behaves byte-identical to today.
notes: Reuses the existing win32-junction link machinery job new already provisions as the resolution signal — not redesigned. One hop only. Hosting site (cli.ts main() vs bin/ shims) is build's call; all candidate files declared so either choice stays in-fence.

summary: Ship a pnpm/npm lockfile-aware setupWorktree helper; migrate the dogfood chain onto it, per spec/RELEASE-v0.7.md §11

new.description: New exported helper, sibling to builtinGates.ts's shellGate/tscGate precedent: pnpm-lock.yaml → pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; package-lock.json → npm ci; neither → refuse cleanly, per §11.
New test file asserting lockfile-detection behavior per §11.

edit.description: Re-export the new helper alongside the existing builtinGates re-exports (~L30-37).
Replace buildSetupWorktree (~L95-103) with the new helper — dogfood discipline.
Rewrite the setupWorktree worked example (~L418-458), currently teaching hardcoded pnpm install, to show the new helper as the recommended default.

tests.asserts: pointed at a pnpm-lock.yaml fixture dir runs pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; pointed at a package-lock.json fixture dir runs npm ci; pointed at neither refuses cleanly.

acceptance: The helper runs pnpm install --frozen-lockfile against a pnpm-lock.yaml fixture, npm ci against a package-lock.json fixture, and refuses cleanly against neither.
notes: Non-goals per spec: yarn/bun lockfile support; migrating connect's own chain.ts (that repo's own follow-up, outside this entry's blast radius).
